decision: Retain lightweight frozen-feature scoring direction; replace original design with bounded three-target controlled pilot.
central_control: Native actual utility versus native best-of-six utility at identical center, approach and decoded width; same inputs, model, loss, samples and seed initialization.
economic_target_control: Auxiliary approximate bridge; not an identification of the original economic-supervision mechanism.
major_corrected_issues: Native weak-valid grasp conflated with failure by direct reuse of original six-class labels
CE is invariant to common logit offsets while original weighted raw-logit decoding is not
Feature/capacity/action information confounded in original S/P design
Original score token already interacts with angle/depth/width tokens
Label-source and geometry differences confounded with potential-versus-actual target
Official training mask includes both distance and top60 view membership
Fixed post-selection oracle is not a full-pipeline upper bound
Non-significance and failed pose coverage do not identify causal or information limits
Official model seen training scenes and limited probe seeds constrain generalization claims
Annotation arithmetic, evaluation cost and assumed resource parallelism need correction
GraRe already covers frozen-detector native-quality reranking
Migration CPU checks do not establish GPU readiness or current capacity
remaining_execution_uncertainties: learnability at chosen sample and update budget
scientific_scope: Executable bounded test, not guaranteed positive or statistically decisive result; uncertainty and technical failure are explicit outcomes.
